scenes.heading: Set limits on messages between sessions

sents.d: Set limits on messages between sessions
Unlimited messaging sounds generous, until it starts eating your evenings and weekends.
Constant texts and emails between sessions add hours for the same fee.
Over time they quietly burn you out.
Say in your agreement how clients can reach you, and when you'll reply, like within one business day.
Bigger questions can wait for the next session.
Offer extra access as a paid upgrade.

take: Define how and when clients can reach you, and charge for extra access.
